clips.title: The story
paras: Orgnil Soulscar is an orc investigator stationed at Razor Hill in central Durotar. He serves as an informal officer of the peace, coordinating defense and intelligence against internal threats to the fledgling nation. His primary concern is the shadow cast by the Burning Blade cult within Durotar's canyons.

Positioned at Razor Hill, Orgnil Soulscar takes on the grim responsibility of tracking subversion and insidious threats across Durotar. While grunt patrols look outward toward Alliance footholds and centaur raiding parties, Orgnil focuses on rot brewing from within. He collects reports from scouts across the region, piecing together evidence of ritual corruption and illicit gatherings.
